regions.name: Chalkmere Terraces
regions.visual: Copper roofs and luminous limestone terraces above dark blue channels.
regions.rumor: The river has kept a second route hidden since the last flood.

sites.name: Collapsed Bellpost
sites.clue: A bell answers from beneath the chalk.
sites.challenge: Strike the exposed bell, trace its reply underground, and open the covered keeper stair.

sites.name: Chalk Cave
sites.clue: A cool mineral draft escapes a narrow crack.
sites.challenge: Follow the cool air through branching shelves; a short Hush shift reveals the return passage.

sites.name: Terrace Watch
sites.clue: A lamp burns in an abandoned watchtower.
sites.challenge: Set two mirrors so the lamp illuminates the old spillway, then face the scavengers drawn by it.

regions.name: Copperwind Vale
regions.visual: Open copper grass and wind towers above braided old roads.
regions.rumor: Toll keepers once charged travelers for roads that moved at night.

sites.name: Split Aqueduct
sites.clue: Two dry channels disagree about where the river went.
sites.challenge: Route Flow into each branch; the one that wets the old masonry exposes a maintenance crawl.

sites.name: Dry Toll Arch
sites.clue: The tally marks continue under the road.
sites.challenge: Use Witness on the buried ledger and choose whose debt to clear before the vault opens.

sites.name: Copper Moth Den
sites.clue: At dusk, copper moths vanish into a hill with no opening.
sites.challenge: Follow their air current rather than the road; spare the nesting queen to learn the wind path.

regions.name: Thistleback Fen
regions.visual: Verdant roots hold houses above mirrored black water.
regions.rumor: A neighbor returned from the drowned census after fifty years and remembered tomorrow.

sites.name: Drowned Census Hut
sites.clue: Names can be read beneath the silt.
sites.challenge: Reconstruct three household entries with Witness to identify the missing sixth vote.

sites.name: Moth Shrine
sites.clue: White moths gather on a root polished by hands.
sites.challenge: Cross by listening for the moths when the path disappears in Hush; a quiet offering changes their route.

sites.name: Reed Prison
sites.clue: Reed cages sway without occupants.
sites.challenge: Graft two cage roots into an escape walkway and free the records sealed inside.

regions.name: Whitecap Scar
regions.visual: Blue slate observatories rise above pale wind-carved ridges.
regions.rumor: The monastery’s second north star follows travelers instead of the sky.

sites.name: Glass Storm Cairn
sites.clue: A past storm burned the stone translucent.
sites.challenge: Align the glass after sunset; avoid the stormglass sentinels and read the shadow it casts.

sites.name: Echo Mine
sites.clue: A second hammer answers each strike.
sites.challenge: Match the hammer echo to locate a hidden worker lift, then bring the trapped miners through.

sites.name: Cloud Step
sites.clue: A narrow tower is visible only from below its shadow.
sites.challenge: Use Lift to reach the upper stair and compare the Wake and Hush horizon marks.

regions.name: Riven Shelf
regions.visual: Hoists and suspended lanes traverse warm stone quarries.
regions.rumor: The oldest mine lifts were built to carry people out, not stone in.

sites.name: Counterweight Quarry
sites.clue: A crane hangs level without its counterweight.
sites.challenge: Find the missing weight by tracing the chain underground; restore the workers’ safe route.

sites.name: Old Pulley Hamlet
sites.clue: Empty homes remain joined by a clever rope web.
sites.challenge: Move the mass dial between hoists to cross the hamlet without snapping the remaining line.

sites.name: Hollow Ore
sites.clue: A seam of ore rings like an empty cup.
sites.challenge: Expose the cavity with Pulse and balance the old rescue cage to enter.

regions.name: Sableglass Steppe
regions.visual: A mirror bright salt plain preserves voices below its crust.
regions.rumor: A vanished caravan sold its own names to escape a census.

sites.name: Salt Hymn Hollow
sites.clue: Each footstep brings a different note from the salt.
sites.challenge: Cross on the tones of the old caravan’s walking rhythm and read the protected names.

sites.name: Buried Causeway
sites.clue: An ancient road appears only at low light.
sites.challenge: Use Witness at the three exposed markers and trace the causeway into a sand chamber.

sites.name: Mirror Salt Well
sites.clue: A salt well reflects a traveler who has already left.
sites.challenge: Shift realms at each reflection, then return the stolen water to the quay.

regions.name: Windward Reach
regions.visual: Kite masts and copper vanes rise over green sea cliffs.
regions.rumor: The wind carries a distress signal from an empty sky.

sites.name: Kite Nursery
sites.clue: Unattended kites tug toward a sheltered cliff.
sites.challenge: Reassemble a torn rescue kite, test it in a low gust, and follow it to its maker.

sites.name: Windwheel
sites.clue: A broken wheel points directly into the prevailing wind.
sites.challenge: Turn the wheel with Pulse and Flow, then take its inner ladder to a survey platform.

sites.name: Low Tide Vault
sites.clue: A door below the cliff can be seen between waves.
sites.challenge: Divert the incoming water and Lift the old grate before the tide returns.

regions.name: Hollow Crown
regions.visual: Navy stone avenues and copper roofs remain frozen at twilight.
regions.rumor: The capital is not ruined; it is waiting for a decision.

sites.name: Silent Market
sites.clue: Coins lie beside stalls that never rotted.
sites.challenge: Read the receipts in both realms; return a merchant’s name to the civic ledger.

sites.name: Buried Council Vault
sites.clue: A council seal glows under black paving.
sites.challenge: Combine Graft Hook, Mass Dial and Concord Crest to expose an alternate account of the vote.

sites.name: Last Lamplighter
sites.clue: One lamp lights itself before every false dawn.
sites.challenge: Follow the lamplighter’s route in Hush, then relight the six public lamps in Wake.

items.name: Emberglass
items.description: Warm glass used to mend a field kit or trade for a small favor.

items.name: Graft Hook
items.description: A living hook that joins severed roots, ropes and old civic conduits.

items.name: Mass Dial
items.description: A portable counterweight that shifts the load on marked machinery.

items.name: Concord Crest
items.description: A paired bearing that holds two true directions at once.

items.name: Waterkeeper Note
items.description: A waterkeeper’s testimony about the refuge gate.

items.name: Caravan Map
items.description: The steppe road as it existed in both Wake and Hush.

items.name: Sixth Ballot
items.description: A living record of the missing fen vote.

items.name: Surveyor Log
items.description: An evacuation diagram hidden in an ore ledger.

items.name: Sky Proof
items.description: A monk’s measurements of the manufactured second north.

items.name: Citizen Record
items.description: The original wording of Vesper Crown’s unfinished choice.

items.name: Kite Thread
items.description: A braided line that carries a person’s weight.

items.name: Salt Key
items.description: A crystal impression of a forgotten road marker.

items.name: Reed Fiber
items.description: Tough fiber for field repairs and simple trade.

items.name: Hush Silk
items.description: A cool strand left by creatures in the held world.

items.name: Moss Heart
items.description: A living knot of fen moss that roots easily in damp ground.

items.name: Wind Quill
items.description: A hollow quill that sings when an aerial current shifts.

items.name: Salt Coin
items.description: An old caravan token whose marks survived the erased ledger.

items.name: Storm Filament
items.description: Conductive thread gathered from charged creatures.

items.name: Brine Scale
items.description: A hard translucent scale from a channel dweller.

items.name: Glass Shard
items.description: A safely wrapped piece of resonant stormglass.

items.name: Iron Grit
items.description: Fine filings from old civic machinery.

items.name: Glint
items.description: The common trade mark accepted by wayhouses.

lore.title: The First Thread
lore.text: Before there were roads, the people called the open sky a loom. They stitched a path by listening to one another breathe.
lore.deduction: The song describes a civic technology as a shared act, not a gift from rulers.

lore.title: The Flood Vote
lore.text: When the river rose, the keepers opened the refuge gate against the council order. The names of those saved were struck from the gauge.
lore.deduction: The official water level was altered to hide an unauthorized rescue.

lore.title: Watch Oath
lore.text: Keep a lamp for the people below the chalk, even if the council calls the chamber empty.

lore.title: Two Rivers
lore.text: A copper river runs toward the sea. A white river runs toward the city. Both have the same fish.

lore.title: Toll Ledger
lore.text: The toll is not coin. Every traveler owes an account of the road they found.

lore.title: Moth Road
lore.text: Follow the moth that flies into wind; it knows which hill has a door.

lore.title: The Sixth Seat
lore.text: Five seats for those who remained. One seat for those the water returned.

lore.title: Moth Oath
lore.text: If a thing changes and still finds home, it is not a stranger.

lore.title: The Returned
lore.text: Do not cure us of the years we lived below. Ask us what we saw.

lore.title: The Other North
lore.text: A second star was hung above the Crown so every road would lead home during the long evacuation.

lore.title: Below the Hammer
lore.text: If the echo answers before the hammer lands, leave the shaft. Something remembers tomorrow.

lore.title: Sky Contract
lore.text: The star guides the lost. When the lost are home, lower the star.

lore.title: Evacuation Lift
lore.text: Four people to a cage; no measure of ore outranks a living body.

lore.title: Rope Families
lore.text: One line holds one house. Two lines hold a street.

lore.title: Refuge in Stone
lore.text: This quarry was a stair while the city forgot the ground.

lore.title: The Nameless Caravan
lore.text: They erased our names from the road. We learned to leave footsteps in salt.

lore.title: Moving Causeway
lore.text: Two maps can both be honest if the world between them has moved.

lore.title: The Well That Waits
lore.text: Give water to the one whose reflection reaches you first.

lore.title: Kite Maker’s Note
lore.text: A tether is a promise that the person in the sky can come home.

lore.title: Wind Station
lore.text: We did not command the storm. We made a place for people to cross it.

lore.title: Coast Refuge
lore.text: The first refugees came by sea, before anyone thought to count them.

lore.title: Market Debt
lore.text: The Crown owes its citizens a morning. The citizens owe the Crown nothing.

lore.title: The Unfinished Question
lore.text: Shall we be held until the danger passes, and asked again when we can answer?

lore.title: Last Lamp
lore.text: If a dawn comes while I sleep, let someone else decide which lamps remain lit.

npcs.name: Mara Vale
npcs.appearance: White hair tied with copper wire; blue work apron; one bare arm marked by a flood line.

schedule.night: reading old flood ledgers at home

lines: You gave the river two ways through. I did not think you would remember the second.
I kept the old maps because I knew you would ask who they were drawn for.

choices.reply: People our council counted as already gone. Take this record and ask them yourself.

lines: Nera. The spillway is humming under a dry sky. Take the threadblade and find the old bellpost west of home.
Stand beside the buried bell and press R to sound your gauntlet with Pulse. Listen to what answers before you take the path to the Sluice.

choices.text: Why does my gauntlet know the river?
choices.reply: Your mother mapped the channels before you could walk. She would have wanted you to choose where the water goes.
Then come back with your own account of what you found.

npcs.name: Tavi Reed
npcs.appearance: Short moss coat, asymmetric courier satchel and a kite charm cut from tin.

schedule.dawn: sorting letters at the Harthwick stair

lines: You followed the moths? I thought the old tale was only a way to send children off the toll road.

choices.text: Show Tavi the moth road on your map.
choices.reply: I will put it in the courier ledger as a shared path. No toll keeper gets to own it.

lines: I can carry a message to every settlement. I cannot decide what it should say for you.

choices.reply: People will argue. They deserve the chance.
I will do it, but I will come back and ask what you left out.

lines: You made the old refuge channel run again. Mara cried and pretended it was spray.
I have roads to run. Send a signal when you find the capital.
At dusk the dry tower rings once. No hand is on the bell.
If you are going beyond the terraces, look for the copper moths in the vale. They know a path off the toll road.

choices.text: I will mark it on my map.
choices.reply: You always do. Please mark the way home too.

npcs.name: Imri Venn
npcs.appearance: Navy scarf over a patched archive coat; ink-dark fingers; a folding slate map.

schedule.day: walking between Rillcross and the aqueduct

lines: I once wrote that the caravan was lost. They erased their names to live.
My correction will not restore what my first account cost them. I can still carry it.

choices.reply: Every road keeper will argue with them. Good.
The road may be public while the people remain safe.

lines: The pipe behind your town matches a line under the old capital. If one record was edited, others may be too.
I came looking for a river that runs uphill. People here insist I should look at the rain.
The city archive called it a mistake. I have learned mistakes can have addresses.

choices.reply: I will keep the ledger. You keep us alive when it bites.

npcs.name: Sava Quill
npcs.appearance: Copper scale plates and a cord of tiny road tokens.

lines: You did not pay the old toll with coin. You found whose journey the ledger hid. The arch is open.
You found the names under the arch. Now we can decide what to do with the debt.

choices.reply: I will witness that choice. Some traders will be furious.
Then let everyone read who wrote the debt in the first place.

lines: The toll arch counts names as if they were loads. I never liked that part of the job.
Read what it hid, then we can decide whether to clear the debt or display it.

npcs.name: Oya Fen
npcs.appearance: Reed-wrapped shoulders, luminous root earrings, water marks that shift with light.

schedule.dawn: meeting the newly returned by the lower bridge
schedule.dusk: holding open council at the assembly stair

lines: The chamber heard us. Now the village must. A seat is a beginning, not an apology.

choices.text: Give the returned a council seat.
choices.reply: We will take it and disagree with you when we must.
It is less than a seat. We will use it until we can ask for more.

lines: We are called returned as though the fen borrowed us. I was born here.
The roots have held every name the census dropped. Hear them before you enter the Parliament.

choices.reply: Then you may find we have a vote, not a curse.

npcs.name: Bren Hollow
npcs.appearance: Broad reed hat and a living rope belt threaded through a wooden hook.

lines: The bridge bends under both of us now. I thought one root had to win.
That hook can join the two roots without cutting either one. The low walkway still needs a shared span.

choices.reply: Take the eastern walkway and listen for the thinner root.

lines: Two roots have been fighting over the lower path for years. The people turned it into a story about enemies.

choices.reply: Take the eastern walkway and listen for the thinner root.

npcs.name: Sel Keel
npcs.appearance: Blue slate mantle, paired lens monocle and an inked horizon across each palm.

schedule.night: copying sky charts in the upper cell

lines: The miners heard an echo before the hammer fell? That is the first measurement my charts cannot explain.

choices.reply: I will add it to the sky record, where anyone can challenge it.

lines: I taught children to trust a star somebody had hung for an emergency. It helped once. It has misled them since.

choices.reply: Then our charts will have margins for doubt.

choices.text: Keep the star as a warning beacon.
choices.reply: We will mark it as made by human hands.

lines: The other north star follows the traveler. That should have been my first clue.
Find the astronomer’s cell before you trust the observatory’s compass.

choices.reply: The sky did not. We will learn the rest together.

npcs.name: Rohn Brack
npcs.appearance: Dust gray coat with bright orange rescue marks; one boot tied with hoist cord.

lines: The lift was built for families. We turned it into a stone conveyor and called that progress.

choices.text: Let the workers run the rescue lifts.
choices.reply: They will keep the safety tally where everyone can read it.

choices.text: Give the lifts to the town council.
choices.reply: Then I will put a worker at every inspection.

lines: If you hear tapping under the shaft, that is me. I can hold out, but the cages cannot.
The first survey line runs toward the capital, not the ore vein. I am going down to see why.

choices.reply: I will tie it to the cage. Thank you.

npcs.name: Pella Spoke
npcs.appearance: Copper braces over a navy mechanic suit; white chalk on every knuckle.

schedule.night: watching the lift from her window

lines: The rescue cage runs again. Rohn says the old dial weighed passengers before ore. That stays in the manual.

choices.text: Show me the chalk marks for the rescue route.
choices.reply: Take the marked route. It should stay safe for whoever comes next.

lines: A cage rose empty last night. Rohn went down to look. Now every bell rings from below.

choices.reply: Take my chalk. The safe plates are marked with circles.

npcs.name: Isca Salt
npcs.appearance: Layered pale shawls and a belt of carefully sealed salt tablets.

schedule.dawn: collecting new salt at the flats
schedule.night: keeping tablets dry beside the well

lines: A memory is not a title deed. Those names belong to the people who carried them.

choices.text: Return the caravan names to their families.
choices.reply: I know where their grandchildren wait.

choices.text: Display the full archive with consent.
choices.reply: I will ask each family before I show a single tablet.

lines: The archive sells a clean story of a caravan that vanished. A clean story usually means somebody scrubbed it.

choices.reply: Find the hollow where footsteps sing.

npcs.name: Vessa Wren
npcs.appearance: Amber flight hood, patched blue sail cloak and fingerless rope gloves.

schedule.dusk: scanning the cliff for missing pilots

lines: The coast can carry people again. I want a station built for whoever comes next, not a monument to those we lost.

choices.text: Open the rescue routes to everyone.
choices.reply: Then the maps go in every wayhouse.

choices.text: Train local pilots to keep the routes safe.
choices.reply: I will teach without charging them for the sky.

lines: My mentor’s kite is above the Loom, but the wind below it is dead.
Bring the lower shutters back and you can reach the spindle.

choices.reply: Take a line. It is a promise, not a leash.

npcs.name: Eiren of the Crown
npcs.appearance: A lantern frame worn as a pack; one navy glove bright with copper dust.

lines: The lamps came on one by one. None were ordered to.
The Crown has a morning now. It will have disagreements too.
The emergency was real. The centuries of silence were a choice no one asked us to renew.
If you have the six instruments, the engine will hear more than the Regent.
A city can survive a night. It cannot survive a night that refuses to end.

choices.reply: Then I will keep one lamp for your return.

quests.title: The River Under Harthwick
quests.introduction: Nera’s tuning gauntlet answers a bell beneath her home. Mara sends her to the dry spillway before another terrace fails.
quests.discovery: Speak to Mara or follow the bell at dusk.

stages.text: Sound the buried bell west of Harthwick.
stages.journal: Mara says to stand by the bellpost and press R to use Pulse. Listen for the channel beneath it.

stages.text: Follow the old water line into Tidemark Sluice.
stages.journal: The bell’s answer points west beneath the terraces.

stages.text: Find what the public gauge concealed.
stages.journal: The oldest flood mark is lower than the newest; the pipes may explain why.

stages.text: Open both paths through the Sluice.
stages.journal: The refuge channel should receive water before the council canal.

quests.title: A Line for the Lost
quests.introduction: The dry wind around Wren Station strands a rescue pilot above the cliffs.
quests.discovery: Watch the stationary kites at Wren Station or speak with Vessa.

stages.text: Reach the kite station on the western coast.
stages.journal: Vessa’s signal ribbons point toward the Loom.

stages.text: Find the stranded pilot above the windless cliff.
stages.journal: The lower shutters can breathe again if the old water feed turns.

stages.text: Release the held storm without losing the rescue route.
stages.journal: The central spindle must be made safe for people, not just kites.

quests.title: The Map That Was Erased
quests.introduction: Imri follows the uphill river into a salt archive that sells a lie about a missing caravan.
quests.discovery: Hear Isca’s caravan song or inspect the singing footprints in Salt Hymn Hollow.

stages.text: Trace the caravan’s route through Sableglass.
stages.journal: The salt remembers footsteps that the map omits.

stages.text: Compare the two archive catalogs.
stages.journal: Wake and Hush record different roads, but neither need be false.

stages.text: Defeat the force erasing living names.
stages.journal: The record belongs to the people who carried it.

quests.title: The Seat Beneath the Roots
quests.introduction: Oya asks Nera to hear the fen’s returned people before the Root Parliament votes on them.
quests.discovery: Listen to Oya at Brackenloft or read names at the drowned census hut.

stages.text: Meet the returned in Brackenloft.
stages.journal: They remember years the public census cannot account for.

stages.text: Take their account to the living chamber.
stages.journal: The sixth seat is buried below the assembly floor.

stages.text: Give the buried electorate a hearing.
stages.journal: The roots need to join without one voice mastering another.

quests.title: The Measure of a Life
quests.introduction: A rescue cage rises empty from the Weight House. Rohn is still below.
quests.discovery: Hear Pella’s night bell in Ferrum Spoke or inspect the unmanned quarry lift.

stages.text: Reach the Riven Shelf hoists.
stages.journal: The old tally weighs people where the new tally counts only ore.

stages.text: Follow Rohn’s safety marks into the shaft.
stages.journal: Use the balance of three cages to descend.

stages.text: Restore the original evacuation cage.
stages.journal: The Counterking is obeying an order long past its use.

quests.title: The Sky That Followed Us
quests.introduction: Two north stars now point to two incompatible futures for the old capital.
quests.discovery: Compare the monastery compass with the shadow at Glass Storm Cairn.

stages.text: Read the sky from Keel Monastery.
stages.journal: Sel says one star follows travelers. The other keeps its place.

stages.text: Find who placed the second star.
stages.journal: The observatory’s missing monk kept measurements in a hidden cell.

stages.text: Turn both bearings toward the Hollow Crown.
stages.journal: The emergency guide must be named for what it was.

quests.title: The Morning Owed
quests.introduction: Nera discovers that Vesper Crown was held between two choices so its citizens could survive a past catastrophe. The Regent still enforces that emergency order.
quests.discovery: Follow the second north to the capital, then listen to Eiren’s six lamps.

stages.text: Walk into the city that never completed its morning.
stages.journal: The old civic lamps are a route, not a royal procession.

stages.text: Bring the six regional instruments below the city.
stages.journal: Each instrument was made to carry a choice, never to make one.

stages.text: End the Regent’s held command.
stages.journal: The final choice should belong to the people who must live with it.

stages.text: Choose how the city records its future.
stages.journal: The Crown owes its citizens the whole question.

quests.title: The People Below the Chalk
quests.introduction: The waterkeeper’s note names a shelter omitted from public maps.
quests.discovery: A bell rings below the collapsed post at dusk.

stages.text: Open the covered keeper stair.
stages.journal: The dry bell answers a second bell below ground.

stages.text: Find the waterkeeper’s account.
stages.journal: The refuge was occupied when the council sealed it.

quests.title: Against the Wind
quests.introduction: Copper moths fly against a wind strong enough to ground kites.
quests.discovery: Watch the moths at dusk west of Rillcross.

stages.text: Follow the moths rather than the toll road.
stages.journal: Their flight points to a hill with a concealed door.

stages.text: Share the route with Tavi.
stages.journal: A route is safer when another courier knows it.

quests.title: The Road’s Old Debt
quests.introduction: The Dry Toll Arch charged people for a moving road.
quests.discovery: Read the tally beneath the arch or speak to Sava.

stages.text: Find whose journeys the ledger omitted.
stages.journal: The numbers are names recorded as loads.

stages.text: Tell Sava what the ledger means.
stages.journal: The road can be made common or the old debt displayed for all to judge.

quests.title: Names Under Water
quests.introduction: Oya asks for a record that the fen cannot wash away.

stages.text: Rebuild the missing household entry.
stages.journal: There were six seats; the public roll names five.

stages.text: Bring the hidden ballot into daylight.
stages.journal: The returned must be allowed to speak for themselves.

quests.title: A Bridge for Two
quests.introduction: Bren’s two roots fight over a bridge the whole village needs.
quests.discovery: Find Bren at the lower walkway.

stages.text: Hear why each root bends away.
stages.journal: Bren says one root has always been called the problem.

stages.text: Restore the low walkway.
stages.journal: Graft a shared span that does not sever either root.

quests.title: The Empty Cage
quests.introduction: Pella heard Rohn tapping from below the quarry.
quests.discovery: Speak to Pella or follow the night bell.

stages.text: Take Pella’s chalk marks.
stages.journal: The circle marks indicate plates that can bear a rescue load.

stages.text: Descend past the unbalanced cages.
stages.journal: Rohn followed a line drawn toward the capital.

stages.text: Bring Rohn up the original evacuation lift.
stages.journal: The lift was made for people before stone.

quests.title: A Hammer Before the Blow
quests.introduction: The Echo Mine answers a strike before it happens.
quests.discovery: Listen at the mine mouth when the wind drops.

stages.text: Find the trapped miners by timing the echo.
stages.journal: The answer marks a safe lift shaft.

stages.text: Tell Sel what the timing implies.
stages.journal: A sky that remembers tomorrow may have been made for evacuation.

quests.title: What the Caravan Kept
quests.introduction: The lost caravan left a rhythm instead of a list of names.
quests.discovery: Follow the singing steps at Salt Hymn Hollow.

stages.text: Cross the hollow on the old walking rhythm.
stages.journal: A wrong note conceals a safe stone rather than punishing the traveler.

stages.text: Recover the caravan’s self-drawn road.
stages.journal: The map is a route, not a claim on the people who took it.

quests.title: A Tether Home
quests.introduction: Vessa’s mentor vanished after launching a rescue kite.
quests.discovery: Find the kite nursery below Wren Station.

stages.text: Repair the tether at the nursery.
stages.journal: A line holds only if both ends remain anchored.

stages.text: Restore the rescue current.
stages.journal: The Loom’s lower shutters feed the lift.

stages.text: Bring the pilot back to Wren Station.
stages.journal: The station needs a route for the next person as much as for this one.

quests.title: The Last Lamplighter
quests.introduction: One lamp lights itself before each false dawn.
quests.discovery: Follow the glowing lamplighter marks without a quest marker.

stages.text: Follow Eiren’s route in Hush.
stages.journal: The six civic lamps form a question mark from above.

stages.text: Return a citizen’s name to the silent market.
stages.journal: A public lamp should light a public record.

quests.title: The Question They Buried
quests.introduction: A council seal lies under black paving beyond the official route.
quests.discovery: A hidden ledger in the Silent Market points toward the Buried Council Vault.

stages.text: Open the council’s alternate record.
stages.journal: All six instruments point to the words cut from the public vote.

stages.text: Read the citizen record before facing the Engine.
stages.journal: The city was supposed to be asked again.

dungeons.title: Tidemark Sluice
dungeons.intro: The terraces drink from a river that no longer reaches them. Nera hears a second current ticking behind the stone.
dungeons.architecture: Copper spillways loop around a central dry well; an older, hand-carved channel runs against the official flow.

rooms.name: The Dry Lip
rooms.description: A carved flood gauge marks two incompatible high-water lines.

rooms.name: Gauge House
rooms.description: Three copper floats can be heard through the wall; their pipes return to the well.

rooms.name: Silt Gallery
rooms.description: Riverglass grazers pick through debris left by the last managed flood.

rooms.name: The Listening Well
rooms.description: Every channel is visible from this shaft, including one that climbs uphill.

rooms.name: Underflow
rooms.description: A concealed race carries water beneath the dry public canal.

rooms.name: Keeper Cell
rooms.description: A waterkeeper hid her refusal to close the city gate.

rooms.name: Wheel Loft
rooms.description: A rusted wheel circles a platform where the Gate Eel guards its nest.

rooms.name: Crown Valve
rooms.description: The valve can feed the terraces or an emergency refuge.

rooms.name: Cistern Heart
rooms.description: The enormous brass throat can flood and drain in one breath.

rooms.name: Return Arch
rooms.description: Fresh water runs through the old hand-cut channel toward Harthwick.

puzzles.title: The Missing Flood
puzzles.clue: The oldest flood mark is below the newest. Follow the pipes, not the painted numbers.

puzzles.title: Water That Climbs
puzzles.clue: The keeper scratched arrows on the underside of the bridge.

puzzles.title: A River Has Two Banks
puzzles.clue: One path fed a city; the other kept people alive.

miniboss.reveal: Its spine is threaded with broken measuring wire; it strikes whenever the wheel stops.

boss.name: The Dry Keeper
boss.silhouette: An empty diving suit held upright by looping copper pipes.

phases.telegraph: A pipe coughs before each sweeping jet.
The gauge glows as the floor begins to fill.
Both valves ring together; one is a false echo.

boss.reward: The Keeper dissolves into clean water. Nera learns Flow by guiding it toward both the town and the forgotten shelter.

dungeons.title: Gale Loom
dungeons.intro: At Wren Station, children launch kites through an impossible lull. Their missing mentor is trapped above the cliffs.
dungeons.architecture: Hanging sail bridges, wind vanes and a central hollow spindle turn a weather station into an aerial instrument.

rooms.name: Lower Anchorage
rooms.description: A row of tethered rescue kites points toward the silent spindle.

rooms.name: Windmouth
rooms.description: Shutters can route the sea gust into three different vertical wells.

rooms.name: Sailwalk
rooms.description: Kite-cutters circle a narrow span that sways with the wind.

rooms.name: Spindle Hollow
rooms.description: The central drum shows every bridge above and below it.

rooms.name: Weaver Nook
rooms.description: A rescued kite maker left a pattern for turning one dangerous gust into a lift.

rooms.name: Crossdraft Balcony
rooms.description: Two currents collide; the safe route is felt before it is seen.

rooms.name: Cutter Perch
rooms.description: The Hookwing Matriarch nests among torn signal flags.

rooms.name: Upper Harness
rooms.description: The loom can pull a rescue platform into the eye of the storm.

rooms.name: Storm Eye
rooms.description: An open arena circles the still center of a violent wind.

rooms.name: Landing Net
rooms.description: The restored station can launch people safely across the reach.

puzzles.title: Borrowed Wind
puzzles.clue: The torn orange sail marks the current that lifts rather than cuts.

puzzles.title: The Quiet Seam
puzzles.clue: The two flags fall still for a heartbeat where the currents meet.

puzzles.title: Rescue Pattern
puzzles.clue: The weaver set three knots in a descending line.

miniboss.reveal: She protects a nest of human signal ribbons, not stolen treasure.

boss.name: The Unmoored
boss.silhouette: A giant hollow sail body with one stone anchor for a heart.

phases.telegraph: Its sail gathers from the left before a slicing gust.
The eye briefly stops, then all loose objects rise.
Its anchor drags sparks across the circular rail.

boss.reward: A gust lifts Nera without a rope. Lift turns the wind into a route home.

dungeons.title: Salt Archive
dungeons.intro: Silt Quay is selling memories as salt tablets. The record of a vanished caravan contradicts every official map.
dungeons.architecture: Layered salt galleries preserve sound in translucent walls; the central catalog belongs to two incompatible histories.

rooms.name: Sunken Steps
rooms.description: Footprints under the salt run toward the entrance, then begin again.

rooms.name: Reading Shelf
rooms.description: Three tablets disagree on the date of the same storm.

rooms.name: Crystal Stacks
rooms.description: Glass-backed archivists rise when a shelf is disturbed.

rooms.name: Double Catalog
rooms.description: Wake and Hush catalogs occupy the same room at different angles.

rooms.name: Caravan Cell
rooms.description: The missing caravan hid its own names to avoid conscription.

rooms.name: Echo Bridge
rooms.description: A bridge exists only while an old footfall is being replayed.

rooms.name: Curator Den
rooms.description: The Brine Curator files living people by the names they once used.

rooms.name: Sealed Index
rooms.description: The true map was cut into two eras and filed as an error.

rooms.name: Memory Vault
rooms.description: A ring of translucent records turns around a black, unwritten center.

rooms.name: West Exit
rooms.description: A new road can be traced across the steppe using the unedited map.

puzzles.title: The Date That Was Removed
puzzles.clue: A scorch line crosses all three tablets; one was carved after the fire.

puzzles.title: Borrowed Footsteps
puzzles.clue: The bridge remembers a caravan moving against the wind. Touch the recalled plate to hold that footfall in place.

puzzles.title: Two Truths
puzzles.clue: Neither half is a forgery; the road moved when the world was hushed. The index holds a fixed impression of each state.

miniboss.reveal: The Curator wears the names of those who survived by becoming anonymous.

boss.name: The Erasure
boss.silhouette: A person-shaped absence with salt pages orbiting an empty head.

phases.telegraph: A page turns toward the true position before an echo attacks.
Two floor maps separate and a bridge flickers between them.
The names on the walls brighten in the order they were hidden.

boss.reward: Nera can Witness the last imprint held in stone, water, and living wood.

dungeons.title: Root Parliament
dungeons.intro: The fen has begun returning people it once swallowed. Their new voices demand a hearing, not a cure.
dungeons.architecture: Living roots weave around an ancient voting chamber; graft points reroute bridges and open witness alcoves.

rooms.name: Threshold of Knots
rooms.description: Petitions are tied to roots instead of posted on a door.

rooms.name: First Vote
rooms.description: A root bridge bends toward whichever voice is loudest.

rooms.name: Seed Vault
rooms.description: Briar jurors guard seeds labeled with human names.

rooms.name: Assembly Trunk
rooms.description: Five galleries encircle a hollow tree where no chair faces outward.

rooms.name: The Empty Seat
rooms.description: A sixth vote was cut out of the living floor.

rooms.name: Graft Ways
rooms.description: A bridge can join two roots without making either obey.

rooms.name: Briar Bench
rooms.description: The Crowned Stag carries old voting bells in its antlers.

rooms.name: Second Vote
rooms.description: The chamber hears those buried beneath it when Witness is used.

rooms.name: Heartwood
rooms.description: The floor opens like a flower around a root-lined pit.

rooms.name: Surface Path
rooms.description: A living bridge grows toward Brackenloft, wide enough for the returned.

puzzles.title: A Quorum of Two
puzzles.clue: A single shout bends the bridge away. Let the unheard root speak with it.

puzzles.title: Neither Must Break
puzzles.clue: The bridge needs a join, not a new master.

puzzles.title: The Buried Ballot
puzzles.clue: Each bell answers a name carved beneath the floor.

miniboss.reveal: Its antlers bear the bells of an electorate erased from the public ledger.

boss.name: The First Speaker
boss.silhouette: A towering woven figure whose many mouths open along one arm.

phases.telegraph: Roots tighten beneath the next striking hand.
One gallery goes dark as the floor reweaves.
Several voices disagree before the Speaker lunges.

boss.reward: The Speaker yields a Graft Hook, a living tool that joins severed pathways without silencing their roots.

dungeons.title: Weight House
dungeons.intro: Quarry lifts move at night while the workers sleep. Ferrum Spoke wants its missing surveyor found before another platform falls.
dungeons.architecture: A vertical network of counterweighted rooms rotates around an open quarry shaft; mass and route are inseparable.

rooms.name: Weight Yard
rooms.description: An empty passenger cage rises when a stone is removed.

rooms.name: Balance Room
rooms.description: Three platforms share one chain, and the marked weight is a lie.

rooms.name: Ore Chute
rooms.description: Iron mites ride falling ore across the route.

rooms.name: Main Shaft
rooms.description: Every lift is visible around a deep shaft that has no bottom from here.

rooms.name: Surveyor Niche
rooms.description: A hidden log proves the quarry was an evacuation machine.

rooms.name: Pendulum Hall
rooms.description: The moving weights form a passage only when their swings oppose.

rooms.name: Crusher Landing
rooms.description: The Iron Mule uses the chain as a weapon and refuses to leave the lift.

rooms.name: Dial Foundry
rooms.description: A portable mass dial waits beneath a false stone mould.

rooms.name: Deep Platform
rooms.description: The arena drops in steps as the old hoist unwinds.

rooms.name: Rescue Cage
rooms.description: The missing surveyor rides up with the restored evacuation cage.

puzzles.title: A Missing Passenger
puzzles.clue: The worker tally counts four bodies. The official scale counts only three.

puzzles.title: Against the Swing
puzzles.clue: The scratched rail shows where the two shadows meet.

puzzles.title: An Honest Measure
puzzles.clue: A dial calibrated to people must never be set by ore alone.

miniboss.reveal: The machine follows an evacuation order centuries after the people left.

boss.name: The Counterking
boss.silhouette: A crown of swinging stone blocks above a narrow armored body.

phases.telegraph: Its largest block rises before the platform drops.
Two cages trade height around the shaft.
The crown splits into three separately balanced weights.

boss.reward: The Mass Dial survives the collapse; Nera can change the burden borne by old machinery.

dungeons.title: Meridian Observatory
dungeons.intro: Keel Monastery teaches that the sky has one fixed north. Its star maps now turn toward the old capital.
dungeons.architecture: Blue slate galleries rotate around a lens tower. Light can cross the same room in Wake and Hush at different angles.

rooms.name: North Gate
rooms.description: A compass carved into the floor has two north marks.

rooms.name: Low Lens
rooms.description: A movable reflector points at a shuttered ceiling.

rooms.name: Night Gallery
rooms.description: Slate sentinels step only where a shadow passes.

rooms.name: The Axis
rooms.description: Six rings can be seen turning around a suspended model of the kingdom.

rooms.name: Astronomer Cell
rooms.description: A monk recorded that a past sky was manufactured, then refused to erase the page.

rooms.name: False North
rooms.description: Two north stars appear at once; only one casts a shadow.

rooms.name: Glass Stair
rooms.description: The Lens Warden crosses between reflected positions.

rooms.name: Crown Ring
rooms.description: The model must face the capital and the coast at the same time.

rooms.name: Upper Dome
rooms.description: The open dome mirrors the horizon into a ring around the player.

rooms.name: South Descent
rooms.description: The real sky returns to the compass, exposing a route through the Hollow Crown.

puzzles.title: The Ceiling Is a Map
puzzles.clue: The missing star was painted on the underside of the shutter.

puzzles.title: Two Norths
puzzles.clue: One star moves with you. The other moves with the room.

puzzles.title: A Shared Horizon
puzzles.clue: The coast and the capital are two bearings of one choice.

miniboss.reveal: Its reflection moves a beat before the body, giving every attack away.

boss.name: The Second North
boss.silhouette: A tall cloaked astronomer with a rotating mirror halo and no visible face.

phases.telegraph: The halo aligns with a floor seam before a beam fires.
The dome displays two skies, then darkens one.
Every mirror faces inward before the final sweep.

boss.reward: The Concord Crest records two true bearings in one instrument, opening the capital without deciding its future.

dungeons.title: Hush Engine
dungeons.intro: Vesper Crown did not fall. The city was held between two decisions so its people could survive a catastrophe outside the walls.
dungeons.architecture: A civic machine under the capital joins all six regional technologies around a central chamber containing the original vote.

rooms.name: Civic Foyer
rooms.description: Names of vanished citizens glow in Wake and their present homes appear in Hush.

rooms.name: Flow Ring
rooms.description: A borrowed river feeds a city that has forgotten thirst.

rooms.name: Wind Ring
rooms.description: The Unmoored fragments ride the ventilation shaft.

rooms.name: Central Dais
rooms.description: Six empty seats face a seventh chair turned toward the exit.

rooms.name: Citizen Record
rooms.description: The original vote asked whether the city could choose again, not whether it should live.

rooms.name: Memory Ring
rooms.description: Salt voices and living roots speak different versions of the same warning.

rooms.name: Wardens Cross
rooms.description: The Twin Wardens protect opposing doors but share one damaged heart.

rooms.name: Concord Bridge
rooms.description: Weight and light must hold the bridge while both world states are heard.

rooms.name: Engine Heart
rooms.description: The city rotates far overhead as the last held breath escapes.

rooms.name: Dawn Stair
rooms.description: People emerge into a world that will answer their choices, including the player’s.

puzzles.title: A River Owed
puzzles.clue: The first flood debt was never paid. Restore the refuge path before feeding the palace.

puzzles.title: The Names Between
puzzles.clue: The record leaves space between two accounts for the people who lived both.

puzzles.title: Neither Silence Nor Command
puzzles.clue: Every mechanism was designed to carry a choice, not make one.

miniboss.reveal: Each warden can be spared by allowing the other to hear the shared heartbeat.

boss.name: The Hush Regent
boss.silhouette: A human figure suspended within six rotating civic machines, one hand open and one clenched.

phases.telegraph: The Regent points to a ring before its mechanism fires.
The arena alternates Wake and Hush as a recorded voice counts.
The clenched hand opens, then the six rings converge.

boss.reward: The Engine stops enforcing a centuries-old emergency order. The final civic choice determines which institutions survive; the world remains explorable afterward.
